studyStatus: Exploratory retrospective validation designed after reading aggregate public-data statistics. Model choices fixed before fitting; this is not a prospective deployment trial.
source: YGPA West Container Terminal vehicle gate visits, public 2026 H1 CSV
target: Elapsed minutes from entry to exit timestamps, not road travel or warehouse unloading duration
timezone: Asia/Seoul inferred from terminal location; not explicit in source CSV
smallGroupFallback: Use global training median; no refitting on validation or test labels
selection: Lowest validation MAE; ties prefer the earlier declared candidate
quality: Discard all-blank rows; retain source records with valid nonnegative entry/exit times. Retain apparent duplicate visits because no stable unmasked identifier is supplied. Missing dates are not zero-volume days.
reporting: Retain all candidate metrics including losses. No PNC fee savings or vehicle/container-level independent sampling claim. Source contains no stable identifier to separate repeat vehicles.
